#!/usr/bin/env python3 """ Sample email script to notify Bob about flight FL658038. Usage: 1. Update the configuration section below with your SMTP and recipient details. 2. Run: python3 notify_bob.py """ import smtplib from email.mime.multipart import MIMEMultipart from email.mime.text import MIMEText from email.mime.base import MIMEBase from email import encoders # ────────────────────────────────────────────── # Configuration – update these before running # ────────────────────────────────────────────── SMTP_SERVER = "smtp.example.com" SMTP_PORT = 587 SMTP_USERNAME = "alice@example.com" SMTP_PASSWORD = "your_app_password_here" SENDER_EMAIL = "alice@example.com" SENDER_NAME = "Alice" RECIPIENT_EMAIL = "bob@example.com" RECIPIENT_NAME = "Bob" # ────────────────────────────────────────────── # Flight details # ────────────────────────────────────────────── FLIGHT_NUMBER = "FL658038" DEPARTURE_AIRPORT = "JFK (New York)" ARRIVAL_AIRPORT = "LHR (London)" DEPARTURE_TIME = "2026-10-15 at 19:00" ARRIVAL_TIME = "2026-10-16 at 07:00" ICS_FILE_PATH = "flight_FL658038.ics" # ────────────────────────────────────────────── # Build the email # ────────────────────────────────────────────── def build_email(): msg = MIMEMultipart("mixed") msg["From"] = f"{SENDER_NAME} <{SENDER_EMAIL}>" msg["To"] = f"{RECIPIENT_NAME} <{RECIPIENT_EMAIL}>" msg["Subject"] = f"Flight Update: {FLIGHT_NUMBER} — {DEPARTURE_AIRPORT} to {ARRIVAL_AIRPORT}" # Plain-text body body_text = f"""\ Hi {RECIPIENT_NAME}, Here are the details for the upcoming flight: ✈ Flight Number : {FLIGHT_NUMBER} 🛫 Departure : {DEPARTURE_AIRPORT} on {DEPARTURE_TIME} 🛬 Arrival : {ARRIVAL_AIRPORT} on {ARRIVAL_TIME} A calendar invite (.ics file) is attached for your convenience. Best regards, {SENDER_NAME} """ # HTML body body_html = f"""\

✈️ Flight Update: {FLIGHT_NUMBER}

Flight {FLIGHT_NUMBER}
Departure {DEPARTURE_AIRPORT} — {DEPARTURE_TIME}
Arrival {ARRIVAL_AIRPORT} — {ARRIVAL_TIME}

A calendar invite (.ics file) is attached for your convenience.

Best regards,
{SENDER_NAME}

""" # Attach both plain-text and HTML alternatives alt_part = MIMEMultipart("alternative") alt_part.attach(MIMEText(body_text, "plain")) alt_part.attach(MIMEText(body_html, "html")) msg.attach(alt_part) # Attach the ICS file try: with open(ICS_FILE_PATH, "rb") as f: ics_attachment = MIMEBase("text", "calendar", method="PUBLISH") ics_attachment.set_payload(f.read()) encoders.encode_base64(ics_attachment) ics_attachment.add_header( "Content-Disposition", f"attachment; filename={ICS_FILE_PATH}", ) msg.attach(ics_attachment) except FileNotFoundError: print(f"⚠ Warning: ICS file '{ICS_FILE_PATH}' not found. Sending without attachment.") return msg def send_email(): msg = build_email() print(f"📧 Connecting to {SMTP_SERVER}:{SMTP_PORT} ...") with smtplib.SMTP(SMTP_SERVER, SMTP_PORT) as server: server.starttls() server.login(SMTP_USERNAME, SMTP_PASSWORD) server.send_message(msg) print(f"✅ Email sent successfully to {RECIPIENT_NAME} <{RECIPIENT_EMAIL}>") if __name__ == "__main__": send_email()
